details: For every finite concept class, $\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{BTD}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: At every Balbach iteration, an ordinary minimum teaching set for a target is still valid: it leaves no other consistent hypothesis, hence no other hypothesis surviving the size filter. Thus every iterated Balbach value is at most its ordinary teaching dimension; maximize at stabilization.
name: Teaching Dimension / Balbach Teaching Dimension
